===/developers/grok-4-7===
# Grok 4.7

Grok 4.7 is SpaceXSI's frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Model name | `grok-4.7` |
| Context window | 500,000 tokens |
| Output limit | No text output limit |
| APIs | [Responses API](/developers/rest-api-reference/inference/responses#create-new-response) |

## Important details

Encrypted reasoning is always returned on the Responses API.

===/developers/rest-api-reference/inference/responses===
* `max_output_tokens` (integer | null) — Max number of tokens that can be generated in a response. Only applies to visible output tokens (i.e. does not apply to tokens used for reasoning or function calls). Defaults to 128,000 when unset; set a larger value to allow longer generations.
